Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring fifty percent of the mathematics portion of the WASL to be short answer or multiple choice questions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring a percent of the mathematics portionof the Washington assessment of student learning be short answer ormultiple choice questions; and adding a new section to chapter 28A.655RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.655RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Fifty percent of the test items on the mathematics portion of theWashington assessment of student learning shall be short answer ormultiple choice questions that measure computation and application ofmathematics formulas that show that the student has the basicmathematics skills for the appropriate grade level as opposed toextended response questions.
